description: Paste an Amazon URL (US, AU, UK, CA, DE, FR, IT or ES) and get its price history: exact lowest, highest, current and average for every price type, plus an approximate dated series read from the chart.

tools.name: chart_get
tools.description: Download the price-history chart PNG for an ASIN. Required: locale, asin, price_types. Optional: range (default: all), width (default: 855), height (default: 513) (plus 3 more).

params.name: price_types
params.description: Price types joined by '-': amazon, new, used (for example amazon-new-used)

tools.name: drops_feed
tools.description: Top price drops as an RSS feed (title holds drop percent, amount, new and old price). Optional: period, category, min-drop.

params.name: category
params.description: Amazon category slug (for example electronics, books, home-kitchen)

params.name: min-drop
params.description: Minimum drop: a currency amount for recent/daily/weekly, or a percent for relative periods

tools.name: drops_list
tools.description: List the top price drops (HTML page). Optional: period, category, min-drop.

params.name: min-drop
params.description: Minimum drop: a currency amount (1, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100) for recent/daily/weekly, or a percent (1-90) for relativedaily/relativeweekly

tools.name: popular_feed
tools.description: Popular products as an RSS feed (current, list and average price). Optional: deals-only.

params.name: deals-only
params.description: 1 = only products at a deal price

tools.name: popular_list
tools.description: List popular products (HTML page). Optional: deals-only.

params.name: deals-only
params.description: 1 = only products at a deal price

tools.name: product_get
tools.description: Fetch the camelcamelcamel product page for an ASIN. The page holds the price summary table (Amazon, 3rd Party New, 3rd Party Used) and product details. An untracked ASIN redirects to the home page. Required: asin.

novel_features.name: Cross-marketplace compare
novel_features.description: See one product's current, lowest and average prices on the US, AU and other Amazon sites side by side.

novel_features.name: Personal price trend
novel_features.description: See how a product's price moved across your own past lookups (history, deal, compare, watch add and watch check save snapshots), including new all-time lows.

novel_features.name: Watchlist near-lows ranking
novel_features.description: Rank every watched product by how close its current price is to its lowest-ever price (needs watch add and watch check first).

novel_features.name: Unseen drops
novel_features.description: Show only the top price drops you have not already seen in earlier pulls.
